title: Weak-lensing radial acceleration relation of KiDS-1000 isolated galaxies: HMG reproduction pipeline
description: Self-contained pipeline that reproduces every figure and table of the paper testing Hyperconical Modified Gravity (HMG) against the KiDS-1000 weak-lensing radial acceleration relation of isolated galaxies, compared with MOND and Lambda-CDM. Runs from scratch (python run_all.py) with only numpy/scipy/matplotlib and the committed data files.
